message.content:
This magazine cover illustration features a grey textured background with a red vertical stripe along the left edge. At the top, text reads “JENDERAL MENGANGGUR / DI MARKAS TENTARA” and “BEREBUT KUASA / MENGELOLA BATAM.” The large grey title “TEMPO” sits above the phrase “ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU.” Bold white block letters in the center state “WASWAS GOLPUT.” Below, smaller text reads: “SURVEI MEMPERKIRAKAN PENINGKATAN JUMLAH MEREKA YANG OGAH MEMILIH PADA PEMILU 2019. KUBU SIAPA YANG DIRUGIKAN?”

The lower half shows the backs of several people standing in a row, facing three large posters. They hold up various machines, including silver compact cameras, black DSLRs, and smartphones, to capture images. One person wears a green sleeveless top, another a blue shirt, and another a light-colored hat. The posters depict pairs of men; some wear black peci hats. Text on the posters includes “JOKOWI - MA’RUF FOR 2019-2024” and “PRABOWO SANDIAGA.” The rightmost poster is oriented sideways. At the bottom left, text includes “4-10 FEBRUARI 2019,” “RP 45.000,” and a barcode.
